user: A solo bookkeeper who reconciles four small retail clients every Monday morning.
problem: Reconciliation takes the whole morning because every client exports a different CSV shape and the bookkeeper re-derives the column mapping by eye each week.
wedge: One buyer, one pain: the Monday reconciliation for these four clients, nothing else in the practice.
primaryJob: Turn four differently shaped weekly exports into one reconciled ledger the bookkeeper can sign off in under fifteen minutes.
primaryArtifact: A reconciled weekly ledger with every unmatched line itemised and attributed to a source file.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: Moves the column-guessing work rather than removing it, and widens the buyer from one bookkeeper to every spreadsheet user.
Requires credentials this wave has no authority to hold, and the clients' banks are not the shared bottleneck.

openUnknowns: Whether the four export shapes are stable week to week or change with each vendor update.
Whether an unmatched line is more costly to miss than a wrongly matched one for this bookkeeper.
successCondition: The bookkeeper completes a Monday reconciliation in under fifteen minutes without hand-editing a column mapping.

prohibited: writing to any accounting system of record
marking a reconciliation as signed off on the bookkeeper's behalf
